properties.name: The Corner Shop
properties.short: Working soda fountain on Main Street in Bramwell, in the old millionaires' coal town.

properties.name: Page Coal and Coke Company Store
properties.short: 1914 brick company store in Pageton, National Register-listed, one of the best-preserved coal camp buildings left in McDowell County.

properties.name: Kimball War Memorial
properties.short: First memorial in the US built to honor African American WWI veterans, restored and open on the hill above Kimball.

properties.name: Coaltown Tavern
properties.short: Burgers, wings, and a full bar in downtown Welch -- the reliable lunch stop on the Head of the Dragon loop.

properties.name: Little Sicily
properties.short: Italian kitchen on Robert C Byrd Drive in Beckley, near the southern gorge approach.

properties.name: Fayette Station Road & Tunney Hunsaker Bridge
properties.short: A steep, switchbacked road descending into the New River Gorge to a river-level bridge beneath the New River Gorge Bridge.

properties.name: Cole Harley-Davidson
properties.short: Family-owned Harley-Davidson dealer in downtown Bluefield - the southern-WV service and gear stop.

properties.name: Sterling Drive-In
properties.short: Classic drive-in in Welch, WV -- quick eats between stops on the Head of the Dragon loop.

properties.name: Skyline Lodge
properties.short: Lakefront motel in Ghent with an on-site pub and grill, a mile from Winterplace - an affordable base in the New River area.

properties.name: Coal Heritage Trail
properties.short: A National Scenic Byway through the historic coal-mining communities of southern West Virginia.

properties.name: Rifrafters Campground
properties.short: Quiet family campground two miles from the New River Gorge Bridge, off Rt 19 - RV, tent, and rustic cabin sites.

properties.name: Bear Mountain Cabins & Campground
properties.short: Cabins, RV, and tent sites a mile from the New River Gorge Bridge - Amish-built cabins and a general store with hand-dipped ice cream.

properties.name: Cathedral Cafe
properties.short: Coffee, breakfast, and lunch inside a converted 120-year-old church in downtown Fayetteville - a New River Gorge staple.

properties.name: Hawks Nest State Park
properties.short: State park in Ansted with a canyon-rim overlook high above the New River Gorge.

properties.name: Summersville Lake Retreat & Lighthouse
properties.short: Cabins, RV and tent sites, vintage campers, pontoon and watercraft rentals, and lighthouse tours — voted Best Campground in West Virginia five years running.
